(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer located on opposite sides of a medial section; and an additional adhesive layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with each other and the additional adhesive layer is situated between the first and second adhesive layers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section includes a honeycomb structure and wherein the medial section is formed from a composite material.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290, wherein the medial section includes a ring having a central opening.

(Currently Amended) Claim 293: The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

(Currently Amended) Claim 294: The tool of claim 281, wherein the weld ring is continuous and supports a plurality of cutting segments on an outer periphery.
